D: A farmer and his family find crop circles in their cornfield and brace for what's coming.
P: Serve the mains when the family sits down to their last supper of favourites.
S: Charred corn cut into wheels, brushed with lime zest and chili butter
Corn cobs grilled over high heat until charred in rings, cut into thick wheels, brushed with butter melted with lime zest and chilli, finished with flaky salt and coriander.
Popcorn tossed with nutty brown butter, parmesan and garlic powder
Popcorn popped in a covered pot, tossed in browned butter, parmesan and a little garlic salt, served in bowls lined with crumpled foil.
Merrill's old minor league bat hanging on the wall

Grilled frankfurts in toasted soft rolls loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and a line of yellow mustard, ballpark style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog rolls. Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, then top with grated cheddar, finely diced white onion and a line of American mustard.
M: everyone picks their favourite for what might be the last meal

Crumbed chicken breast fried golden, topped with napoli, leg ham and bubbling mozzarella, finished under the grill, with chips and a sharp green salad. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Heat the oven grill. Top each with 3 tbsp napoli sauce, a slice of leg ham and 50g grated mozzarella, then grill for 4 minutes until bubbling. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss a green salad in lemon and oil.
Beef chuck braised 3 hours with carrots, celery and potatoes
Beef chuck seared hard, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes added for the last hour, gravy from the pan.
W: Buttermilk biscuits split and filled with strawberries and cream
Split buttermilk biscuits piled with sugared strawberries and soft whipped cream. Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick.
K: Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower blended and strained, served cold

Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower blended and strained, topped with cold sparkling water over ice and cucumber ribbons, poured into mismatched glasses. Blend 1 continental cucumber with a cup of mint leaves, the juice of 3 limes and 80ml elderflower cordial, then strain through a sieve into a jug. Chill for an hour. Fill mismatched glasses with ice and a few thin cucumber ribbons, pour in the base to a third full and top with 1 litre chilled sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lime and chilli butter up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; grill the corn, cut and brush to serve

steps.text: Grill the corn over high heat, turning, until charred in rings.
Cut into thick wheels.
Brush with the butter mixed with lime zest and chilli flakes. Finish with flaky salt and coriander.

dishes.make_ahead: Brown the butter and grate the parmesan up to 2 days ahead; pop and toss just before serving

steps.text: Pop the kernels in a covered pot with the oil.
Brown the butter until nutty and toss through the popcorn with the parmesan and garlic powder.
Serve in bowls lined with crumpled foil.
Brown the beef hard on all sides in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots, celery, stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.
Lift out the meat and veg. Thicken the juices with the flour into gravy.
Peel the celeriacs and brown hard on all sides in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots, celery, stock, soy sauce and thyme. Cover and braise at 180C for 45 minutes.
Add the potatoes and braise until everything is tender.
Lift out the celeriac and veg. Thicken the juices with the flour into gravy and carve the celeriac into wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the biscuits up to 1 day ahead, airtight, and rewarm; slice and sugar the strawberries up to 2 hours ahead, then whip the cream and fill to serve

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour and a little of the sugar, add the buttermilk and pat out 2cm thick.
Cut into rounds and bake at 220C for 13 minutes.
Toss the strawberries with the rest of the sugar and stand for 20 minutes.
Split the biscuits and fill with strawberries and whipped cream.

steps.text: Blend one cucumber with the mint, the juice of three limes and the cordial, then strain through a sieve into a jug.
Chill for an hour.
Slice the second cucumber into thin ribbons. Fill glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons.
Pour the base in to a third full and top with sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.

s.note: Charred corn cut into wheels, brushed with lime zest and chili butter
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat until charred in rings. Cut into thick wheels and brush with 50g butter melted with lime zest and chilli flakes. Finish with flaky salt and coriander.

s.note: Popcorn tossed with nutty brown butter, parmesan and garlic powder
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in a covered pot. Brown 50g butter until nutty and toss through with 40g grated parmesan and a little garlic powder. Serve in bowls lined with crumpled foil.

m.note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours with carrots, celery and potatoes
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg beef chuck hard. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 500ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Thicken the juices into gravy.

w.note: Buttermilk biscuits split and filled with strawberries and cream
w.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick. Cut 6 rounds and bake at 220C for 13 minutes. Toss 500g sliced strawberries with 3 tbsp sugar and stand 20 minutes. Split the biscuits and fill with strawberries and 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower blended and strained, served cold
d.how: Blend 1 continental cucumber with a cup of mint leaves, the juice of 3 limes and 80ml elderflower cordial, then strain through a sieve into a jug. Chill for an hour. Fill mismatched glasses with ice and a few thin cucumber ribbons, pour in the base to a third full and top with 1 litre chilled sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
